niche_card.name: Frog & toad call archives (regional fonotecas)
niche_card.RAW: Original .wav/.mp3 advertisement-call recordings with accession numbers, on regional fonoteca and lab sites
niche_card.UNIT: One calling male — thousands of accessions per fonoteca, hundreds of species, standard field-recorder protocol
niche_card.LABEL_GAP: Call filed under the species name at recording vs the DNA-split taxonomy of today (second ruler)
niche_card.headline: A frog smaller than your thumbnail has a unique voice — and thousands of taped voices are filed under species that have since been split in three.
niche_card.why_niche: Fonoteca Zoológica (Madrid), Fonoteca Neotropical and university piles each hold their own accessions; the big platforms host photos, not these accessioned raw calls.
niche_card.score_justification: The task's own example: raw .wav/.mp3 per species, regional sound libraries, call IDs vs DNA-split species.
